title: Create industry query map (Pexels search queries per slot per industry)
description: Create src/lib/images/industry-queries.ts with predefined Pexels search queries for each image slot (hero, gallery, about, etc.) per industry. This ensures industry-appropriate images are fetched automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Queries exist for all major image slots: hero, gallery, about, services, team
Queries exist for at least 10 industries: roofing, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, cleaning, painting, hvac, construction, locksmith, pest_control
Fallback query returned when industry/slot combination not found

steps.details: For each industry (roofing, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, cleaning, painting, hvac, construction, locksmith, pest_control) define at minimum: hero, gallery, about, services queries. Make queries specific enough to get relevant results from Pexels.
